subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine recovery archives be silently deleted after a fixed five-file limit, or should bounded cleanup use a different operator-visible retention and recovery contract?
rationale: The branch changes the lifetime of persisted recovery data; code review cannot determine whether five archives, silent deletion, or another cleanup mechanism matches the intended operator and recovery guarantees.

options.title: Approve five-file silent retention
options.body: Accept the current implementation, documenting that only the five newest cron quarantine recovery archives are retained.

options.title: Define a recoverable bounded policy
options.body: Choose a bounded retention design that preserves an explicit operator recovery path before implementing deletion behavior.

options.title: Split out archive pruning
options.body: Land only the bounded read/write and overflow recovery work, leaving archive retention unchanged until a separate policy decision is made.

recommendation.title: Define a recoverable bounded policy
recommendation.body: Choose a bounded retention design that preserves an explicit operator recovery path before implementing deletion behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The thread already routes the unresolved retention choice to this person, and the choice is product-policy rather than contributor follow-up.
